recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for core reconciliation. If future semantic changes are needed for these Questionnaire layout hints, make them in the FHIR Extension Pack and coordinate with the relevant extension-pack Jira issue rather than editing core FHIR source.
issue_request: FHIR-5956 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core Questionnaire request for additional rendering/layout hints: autocomplete for large choice lists, select/drop-down for shorter choice lists, and horizontal rendering for choices or groups. The final PC WG resolution replaced the three proposed extension URLs with two generic extensions, one for direction/orientation and one for control type.
initial_application: Jira records SVN #6652 as the original application. In imported git history, commit 52dbc1c478 contains the corresponding core Questionnaire extension family: item-control terminology with autocomplete, drop-down, lookup, radio-button, slider, spinner, and text-box controls, and choice-list orientation terminology with horizontal and vertical values.
additional_context: Questionnaire remains an active core resource, but the seed extension definitions are no longer active core-source artifacts. Commit dd468d4f17 removed questionnaire-choiceOrientation, questionnaire-itemControl, and their code system/value set files from R5 core source. The FHIR Extension Pack now contains active questionnaire-itemControl and questionnaire-choiceOrientation definitions plus their bound terminology. Later related issues such as FHIR-43033, FHIR-31347, and FHIR-32979 refine the same extension family without reversing the seed decision.
reconciliation: No core source change was made. Recreating or editing these extension definitions in the core checkout would conflict with the current Extension Pack ownership model.
